correctness.rationale: The VC upper bound uses a two-short-gap propagation obstruction, proving n >= 3k-1 for every shattered k-query support. Each residue class n=3k-1,3k,3k+1 has an explicit realizable k-query support; the directed gap filling follows because all integers at least two are sums of twos and threes. For the first adaptive threshold, two differently implemented exhaustive checkers agree for each n=3..13. A complete depth-five C13 tree has 32 distinct leaf witnesses; 39 concepts exclude depth six. The five-query trace census covers all 1287 supports. The product lemma is proved for both dimensions, yielding exact gaps on all m-fold disjoint copies of C13.

value.rationale: A full exact VC formula across every finite cycle and hence every finite 2-regular graph is a natural classification of a learning-theoretic invariant. The first adaptive deficit at the thirteen-cycle is a sharp threshold in connected vertex-transitive degree-two graphs, supported by a complete decision-tree certificate and 1287-support trace census. Identical cycles amplify the gap linearly while preserving both regularity and vertex transitivity, a structural property not supplied by earlier disjoint path examples. The result is mathematically motivated without requiring a general Ldim formula for longer cycles.
